edited_fraction: whole network for written models; unclear for edits of pretrained checkpoints
cost_reported: yes: API-price equivalent per run, $2-$490 (e.g. $144 for a 3.35M LLM-designed generation-5 model)
evidence_notes: Writers (Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra) work in a sandbox with shell tools and deliver a build/edit script that compiles hand-written files into weight tensors; they can run the model on CPU on self-made practice questions and later generations see the parent's validation accuracy (p19-20), hence closed-loop. Released architectures up to 2.6B (Gemma 2 2B) were written or edited (p7, p22); costs on p7 and p21. Written Transformers score below BM25 over the LLM's own text and fine-tuned models are far more accurate (p1, p10); title page carries a Code link; no preregistration or LLM-authoring statement found.
